beaches.name: Spiaggia della Bassona, Lido di Dante (spiaggia naturista)
beaches.summary: Nude use is permitted on a marked 400 m stretch south of Lido di Dante. A seasonal Comune di Ravenna mayoral ordinance, first signed 25 June 2020 and last confirmed renewed for 25 May–22 September 2024, allows 'clothing optional' use from 50 m past the pine-wood path for about 400 m, marked by a windbreak and signs. Dune crossing outside the paths is prohibited; the designation applies only to the marked stretch.
